text:
kai (product-ops): quick sync request — we need to nail sequencing for the Quill-edge prewarm pilot. customer asks: private pilot w/ KMS/HSM, deterministic p95 latency SLAs. main outputs: launch criteria, who reserves infra slots, runtime flag plan, security checklist. can folks call out blockers?

maria (PM): TL;DR timeline idea: reserve infra + security signoff (block A), runtime changes behind a flag + e2e perf tests (block B), 3-customer canary (block C). target pilot start ~2w after infra sloting.

raj (eng-runtime): blocker: prefix/KV prewarm touches hot path. we can gate behind a flag but need 2 perf benches: 1) steady-state p95 with prefix cache, 2) cold-start penalty. rough scope: ~6 dev sprints to make consistent and add metrics. also need a small API extension to expose "warmness" header for observability.

lisa (eng-infra): capacity note: to guarantee 50 qps sustained + 2x burst for pilot we should pin 8 A100-equivalent GPUs in Dedicated pool for the pilot window. that avoids noisy neighbors. autoscaler will need an exclusion rule for prewarm nodes — we can carve a reserved pool. ETA to reserve: 5 business days once PM approves numbers and billing owner.

omar (security): security checklist highlights: KMS integration diagram, HSM attestation notes, key rotation policy, audit log retention (90d default, can extend), threat model for private control-plane callbacks. on-prem customers will require HSM attestation from day 0. need a short runbook for compromised-key rotation.

kai (product-ops): good. can we get concrete "minimal launch criteria" proposals? i.e., p95 <= 120ms for <=512 tokens, cold-start <= 300ms for cached prefixes, capacity reserved for 50 qps sustained, audit logs enabled, KMS path verified. are these reasonable?

raj (eng-runtime): p95 <= 120ms if prefix cache is warmed and model variant is quantized — yes on paper. cold-start 300ms is optimistic for some hardware; suggest 400ms safe. we can aim for 300ms as stretch. will add telemetry tags: prefix_hit=true/false.

lisa (eng-infra): reservation confirmed pending billing owner. also: prewarm workload will interfere with cluster-level GPU packing. we should run the pilot in its own rack allocation to avoid eviction. need confirmation of budget and rack preference.

maria (PM): ack. i'll confirm budget today and loop in finance. sequence proposal:
- A: security artifacts + infra budget + reserve pool (owners: omar + lisa)
- B: runtime flag + perf harness + observability (owner: raj)
- C: staged canary (3 customers) + acceptance tests (owners: maria + kai)
Can we set a go/no-go checkpoint after B (perf harness green)?

omar (security): yes. security can sign off after the KMS smoke test and the runbook exists. timeline: we can do the smoke test within 3 business days once we have an environment.

kai (product-ops): ok let's pick next steps. raj, can you scope the runtime changes into 3 Jira tickets (flag, metrics, e2e bench) by EOD tomorrow? lisa, can you start capacity reservation request and include rack constraints? omar, draft the minimal security checklist doc and attach HSM attestation requirements. i'll collate into a sequencing storyboard and propose dates.

raj (eng-runtime): will do. quick note: sample config we'll use for bench:
```
prewarm: { enabled: true, reserved_threads: 24, capacity: { sustained_qps: 50, burst_qps: 100 } }
```
will attach perf numbers when benches run.

lisa (eng-infra): starting reservation ticket now. pinging @finance for approval. also adding an exclusion to the autoscaler policy: `nodePool: quill-pilot-reserved`.

omar (security): drafting checklist, will include KMS flow diagram + expected audit events list. attaching to ticket in ~48h.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary window: staging -> canary (3 tenants) when @raj marks bench:green and @omar marks security:approved.

maria (PM): great. final ask: if anyone expects major scope creep or alternative sequencing (e.g., do runtime changes after a smaller canary), flag it now. otherwise i'll produce the sequencing storyboard and a proposed pilot week dates tomorrow. :thumbsup:

kai (product-ops): thanks all. if you want to discuss live, brief sync at 10am tomorrow. otherwise i'll share the storyboard in this thread.
